questions.question: Is ground-fault protection required for a 2000 A, 208 V service?
questions.question_fa: آیا برای یک سرویس ۲۰۰۰ A با ولتاژ ۲۰۸ V، ground-fault protection لازم است؟
questions.answer_fa: خیر. ground-fault protection of equipment روی سرویس‌های solidly grounded تنها زمانی الزامی است که سرویس ۱۰۰۰ A یا بیشتر باشد و ولتاژ نسبت به زمین بیش از ۱۵۰ V باشد (مثلاً ۳۴۷/۶۰۰ V). یک سرویس ۲۰۸ V (که ۱۲۰ V نسبت به زمین است) از ۱۵۰ V فراتر نمی‌رود، بنابراین لازم نیست.
questions.answer: No. Ground-fault protection of equipment for solidly grounded services is mandated only on services rated 1000 A or more at more than 150 V to ground (e.g., 347/600 V). A 208 V (120 V to ground) service does not exceed 150 V to ground, so it is not required.
solution_steps: Rule 14-102 requires GFP on solidly grounded services 1000 A and larger that are over 150 V to ground.
208Y/120 V is only 120 V to ground — at or below 150 V — so GFP is not required regardless of the 2000 A rating.

questions.question: What size of overcurrent protection is needed to protect an equipment wire, size #16 AWG?
questions.question_fa: برای حفاظت از یک equipment wire با سایز #16 AWG، چه اندازه‌ای overcurrent protection لازم است؟
questions.answer_fa: هم 15 A و هم 20 A (یک equipment wire با سایز #16 AWG را می‌توان در 15 A یا، تحت شرایط مجاز، در 20 A حفاظت کرد)
questions.answer: Both 15 A or 20 A (a #16 AWG equipment wire may be protected at 15 A or, under the permitted conditions, at 20 A)
solution_steps: Overcurrent protection for conductors is governed by Rule 14-104 / Table 13.
The keyed answer treats #16 AWG equipment wire as permitted at 15 A or 20 A. Flagged: the exact OCP allowance for #16 equipment wire was not confirmed against Table 13 text.

questions.question: For space-heating installations, what type of fuses must be used?
options: B) Type D or Type P fuses
questions.question_fa: برای نصب‌های space-heating، چه نوع fuse باید استفاده شود؟
options_fa: Type D یا Type P fuses
questions.answer_fa: Type D یا Type P fuses (fuseهای time-delay/HRC که برای بار cycling مربوط به space heating مناسب‌اند)
questions.answer: Type D or Type P fuses (time-delay/HRC-type fuses suited to the cycling load of space heating)
solution_steps: Space-heating circuits use time-delay fuses to ride through cycling/inrush.
The source specifies Type D or Type P fuses. Flagged: fuse class and rule reference not confirmed against the code text.

questions.question: Is ground-fault protection required for a circuit at 110 V and rated at 2500 amps?
questions.question_fa: آیا برای مداری با ولتاژ ۱۱۰ V و rating ۲۵۰۰ A، ground-fault protection لازم است؟
questions.answer_fa: خیر. هرچند جریان ۱۰۰۰ A یا بیشتر است، اما ۱۱۰ V از ۱۵۰ V نسبت به زمین فراتر نمی‌رود، بنابراین equipment ground-fault protection طبق Rule 14-102 لازم نیست.
questions.answer: No. Although the current is 1000 A or more, 110 V does not exceed 150 V to ground, so equipment ground-fault protection under Rule 14-102 is not required.
solution_steps: Rule 14-102 GFP applies to solidly grounded systems 1000 A or larger that exceed 150 V to ground.
110 V is below 150 V to ground → GFP not required.

questions.question: What is the maximum interrupting rating of a 480 V, 125 A circuit breaker (unless specifically marked otherwise)?
questions.question_fa: حداکثر interrupting rating یک circuit breaker با مشخصات 480 V و 125 A چقدر است (مگر آنکه به‌طور مشخص طور دیگری marked شده باشد)؟
solution_steps: Unless specifically marked with a higher interrupting capacity, a circuit breaker is taken to have a default interrupting rating of 10,000 A symmetrical (Rule 14-012/14-606).
Voltage (480 V) and frame size (125 A) do not change this default.

questions.question: Is ground-fault protection required for an 800 A, 600/347 V, 3-phase, 4-wire service?
questions.question_fa: آیا برای یک سرویس ۸۰۰ A، ۶۰۰/۳۴۷ V، سه‌فاز، چهارسیمه، ground-fault protection لازم است؟
questions.answer_fa: خیر. ولتاژ سیستم نسبت به زمین (۳۴۷ V) از ۱۵۰ V فراتر می‌رود، اما سرویس ۸۰۰ A است — پایین‌تر از آستانه ۱۰۰۰ A در Rule 14-102 — بنابراین equipment ground-fault protection لازم نیست.
questions.answer: No. The system voltage to ground (347 V) exceeds 150 V, but the service is rated 800 A — below the 1000 A threshold of Rule 14-102 — so equipment ground-fault protection is not required.
solution_steps: Rule 14-102 requires GFP only where BOTH conditions hold: service rated 1000 A or more AND more than 150 V to ground.
347 V to ground exceeds 150 V, but 800 A is less than 1000 A, so GFP is not mandated.

questions.question: What is the maximum rating of a plug fuse?
questions.question_fa: حداکثر rating یک plug fuse چقدر است؟
solution_steps: Plug fuses (Type T / Type S) are limited to a maximum rating of 30 A.
Of the options, 30 A is the maximum.

questions.question: A three-conductor 3/0 copper TW75 cable is installed to supply a 200 A non-continuous load. Determine the maximum size of circuit breaker permitted for this installation.
questions.question_fa: یک کابل سه‌رشته 3/0 مسی TW75 برای تغذیه یک non-continuous load با مقدار 200 A نصب شده است. حداکثر اندازه circuit breaker مجاز برای این نصب را تعیین کنید.
questions.answer_fa: 200 A. ampacity هادی 3/0 Cu TW75 (Table 2) برابر 200 A است؛ برای یک non-continuous load، overcurrent device بر اساس ampacity هادی sizing می‌شود، بنابراین حداکثر breaker برابر 200 A است.
questions.answer: 200 A. The 3/0 Cu TW75 conductor ampacity (Table 2) is 200 A; for a non-continuous load the overcurrent device is sized to the conductor ampacity, so the maximum breaker is 200 A.
solution_steps: From Table 2, 3/0 AWG copper at 75 degC (TW75) has an ampacity of 200 A.
Rule 14-104 sizes the overcurrent device at the conductor ampacity, or where that does not correspond to a standard size, the next lower standard size; 200 A is itself a standard size (Table 13).
Maximum permitted circuit breaker = 200 A.

questions.question: What must be the rating of general-use switches controlling incandescent lighting in public assembly areas?
questions.question_fa: rating سوئیچ‌های general-use که روشنایی incandescent را در محل‌های تجمع عمومی کنترل می‌کنند، باید چه باشد؟
questions.answer_fa: باید general-use switchهای "T"-rated (tungsten-rated) باشند، زیرا لامپ‌های incandescent (با فیلامان tungsten) جریان inrush بالایی می‌کشند.
questions.answer: They must be "T"-rated (tungsten-rated) general-use switches, because incandescent (tungsten-filament) lamps draw high inrush current.
solution_steps: Incandescent/tungsten lamps have high inrush, so general-use switches controlling them must be marked for tungsten ('T') loads.
Flagged: the 'T'-rating requirement is correct in principle, but the exact rule reference was not confirmed against the code text.

questions.question: According to the requirement, what is the maximum permitted clearing time when a ground-fault current of 3000 A or higher occurs?
questions.question_fa: طبق این الزام، حداکثر clearing time مجاز هنگامی که یک ground-fault current برابر 3000 A یا بیشتر رخ می‌دهد چقدر است؟
questions.answer_fa: 1.0 ثانیه (ground-fault protection باید یک ground-fault current برابر 3000 A یا بیشتر را در حداکثر 1 ثانیه clear کند)
questions.answer: 1.0 second (ground-fault protection must clear a ground-fault current of 3000 A or more within a maximum of 1 second)
solution_steps: Rule 14-102 sets a maximum operating (clearing) time for equipment ground-fault protection.
For a ground-fault current of 3000 A or higher, the maximum clearing time is 1.0 second.
